name: Twilight Parade: Moonlit Mononoke
description:
Twilight Parade: Moonlit Mononoke is a side-scrolling bullethell SHMUP where beautiful yokai girls will fly through 5 yokai-infested levels celebrating the Hyakki Yagyō, the night parade of the hundred yokai. Fly, shoot, dodge. Put an end to their party!

Every year yokai take to the streets to party at the Hyakki Yagyō, the night parade of the hundred yokai. But this year they didn't invite the oni twins because they're too rowdy, so they're going to ruin the party! Face hordes of yokai in this side-scrolling shmup and let's END THE PARTY!

  • 4 beautiful Yokai Girls as playable characters in Pixel Art style, each with a different type of assistant, plus their beachwear version!

  • 5 levels full of angry yokai, each with a giant boss at the end!

  • Retro bullethell gameplay.

  • Horizontal levels in a nostalgic Pixel Art style.

  • Bullets, lots of bullets!

Blue Oni Sister

The funniest and cutest twin, she has only one horn and likes sweets and cake. Her assistant is a Tanuki that shoots in a circular pattern.

Red Oni Sister

The hot-headed and impulsive twin, she has two horns and likes spicy food and curry. Her assistant is a Tanuki who follows her path, shooting.

kitsune

She is the spirit of a fox who lives in a pipe and grants wealth and magical powers to those she likes. Her assistants are two little foxes that shoot in a circular pattern.

Gyokuto

She is a rabbit girl who lives on the moon and uses her hammer to make Mochi. Her favorite food is Mochi and her assistants are two rabbit-shaped mochis.
